name: jet
description: Full language server (M13) for the Jet language: completion, hover, go-to-definition, references, rename, semantic tokens, inlay hints.

jet.languageServerPath.description: Path to a jet binary (must support `jet lsp`). Leave empty to auto-discover: ${workspaceFolder}/target/debug/jet, then `jet` on PATH.

jet.inlayHints.cloneHints.description: Show .clone() hints at implicit clone sites (L0201). On by default per D-LSP8.

jet.inlayHints.typeAnnotations.description: Show inferred types on val/var bindings. Off by default per D-LSP8.
